name: Average Teaching Dimension of the Repetition-Free Teaching Separation Class
proof: For the thirteen displayed strings in the class definition, exhaustive inspection of coordinate subsets gives the individual minimum teaching-set sizes $2,2,4,4,3,3,3,3,3,4,3,3,3$.  Their sum is $40$, so the average is $40/13$; the enumeration is checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_repetitionfree\_teaching.py}$.
